To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Mexican Americans who are more acculturated to the North American culture perceive counselors as being less credible.
Mexican Americans who are acculturated into Mexican culture are more likely than those who are acculturating into the dominant North American culture to rate their counselors as credible.

(a) Mexican American students rated counselors as less credible when the counselor used the Mexican American model of helping than when the counselor used a more North American model; and (b) the more Mexican Americans adhered to Mexican cultural norms, the less credible they rated counselors who used a Mexican American model of counseling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of counselor model of helping and participant ethnicity and acculturation level on perceived counselor credibility.
the relationship between counselor credibility and participant ethnicity.
the relationship between counselor model, participant ethnicity, and acculturation level and counselor credibility.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the counselor's model of helping and participant's ethnic background are related to perceptions regarding the counselor's credibility.
the results of this study support the hypothesis that acculturation level and counselor model of helping are related to perceived counselor credibility.

the results of the present research suggest that counselors should not only become knowledgeable about cultural differences and their implications for counseling, but also become knowledgeable about the Mexican culture in order to be able to provide effective counseling services to Mexican Americans.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the results of this study suggest the need for counselors to be aware of the cultural values and beliefs of their clients.
counselor credibility is related to counselor model of helping and that counselor credibility is affected by acculturation level and ethnicity of the participant.
counselor expertise and trust are important factors in counseling and that counselor credibility can be enhanced by the development of multicultural counseling competencies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
counselors should be aware of the cultural norms and behaviors that Mexican Americans value and incorporate these into their practice.
counselors should not assume that Mexican Americans will not seek out or utilize counseling.
the cultural barrier theory does not apply to all Mexican Americans.
